description: Paste one or more YouTube video URLs (watch pages, youtu.be links, Shorts, or raw video IDs) and choose how many comments and replies to collect.

includeReplies.description: Collect reply threads as separate rows linked to their parent via parentCommentId. Replies are charged at the same per-comment rate — there is no reply surcharge.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Hard limit on top-level comments per video. The Actor never returns — or charges for — more than this. Set 0 for the maximum (10,000).
maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max top-level comments per video

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Cap on replies collected for each top-level comment. Set 0 for all available replies (safety ceiling 1,000).
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max replies per comment

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cost cap for the whole run, estimated at the free-plan event price ($0.0009/comment). The run stops before the estimate passes this amount. Paid plans pay less per event, so the cap is conservative. Set 0 for no cap.
maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Maximum total charge (USD)

sortBy.description: Order comments the way YouTube does: 'top' (most relevant/liked) or 'newest' (most recent first).
sortBy.title: Sort order

videoUrls.description: YouTube video URLs (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live) or bare 11-character video IDs. Up to 50 videos per run.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs

title: YouTube Comments Scraper input
